archetype_rationale: Kyutai spin-out building ultra-low-latency speech/audio foundation models - model research core.

1.evidence: article: custom audio models with 'ultra-low latency' - research-grade speech tech

2.evidence: voice agents fully buildable on commodity STT/LLM/TTS APIs; their edge is frontier latency

3.evidence: single vertical voice bot (e.g., restaurant booking) is small scope

5.evidence: public APIs + client call scripts suffice

7.evidence: first sellable voice agent in weeks-months

9.evidence: 'AI receptionist for X' is a proven productized agency offer

11.evidence: voice-agent template white-labels across clients beautifully

14.evidence: client needs an ops owner, not engineers

20.evidence: owner/operators and ops managers reachable directly

22.evidence: article: Nvidia joined FirstMark, Eurazeo, DST, Schmidt, Niel

25.evidence: voice space crowding fast (ElevenLabs, Retell et al.)

27.evidence: end-buyers are highly reachable SMBs/mid-market via the service analog

28.evidence: speech-model pretraining deep; API path bypasses it

30.evidence: audio corpora moat for THEM; irrelevant to agency route

33.evidence: agency route works at any scale

42.evidence: multilingual voice adds work but APIs cover it

45.evidence: FM vendors ship native voice - wrapper risk real but delivery layer persists

49.evidence: low barrier invites copycat agencies; race to bottom on simple bots

51.evidence: calling the bot live in a sales meeting is the ultimate demo

52.evidence: funded voice startups + their target verticals are warm leads

agency_play.build_scope: Partial functionality: vertical voice agents (booking, intake, order-status) on commodity STT-LLM-TTS stacks with telephony - replicating Gradium's use cases while they build the frontier model underneath.
agency_play.packaging: Productized 'AI Receptionist' per vertical with setup fee + per-minute hosting; multilingual and after-hours add-ons.
agency_play.first_clients: Dental/medical groups, home services, restaurants chains - high call volumes, staff shortage pain, demo-ready.
